title: skill-engine source-paths.json
description: Registry of the upstream sources a contextualizer tracks. This file is the machine-readable transcription of the contract that verify.sh Check 1 (source-paths-shape) and Check 2 (source-entries) enforce at audit time. One semantic rule is not expressible in JSON Schema and remains enforced only by verify.sh: web-doc page_list URLs must share an origin with the source url. Schema evolution is additive — unknown keys are tolerated (additionalProperties is open) so older and newer files validate against the same contract. Optional cross-axis fields (url/path/sitemap_url on the kinds where they are not required) accept an explicit null or an empty string as equivalent to absent, matching verify.sh's `.field // ""` defaulting plus its non-empty-string (`[ -n ... ]`) reading; the page_list array likewise treats null or an empty array as absent. The required field for each kind must still be a non-empty value (minLength 1).

schema_version.description: Schema version. Additive evolution; v1 is still current.

sources.description: The tracked sources. May be empty (no sources registered yet).

probe_budget.description: Document-root, optional. Caps how many probe-promoted sources REFRESH carries into re-read scoping in a single session. The Phase 1 probe itself is never capped: every in-scope source is probed every session, because this budget bounds model-token cost, not network cost. Absent means every promoted source proceeds to re-read. Values 0, negative integers, and non-integer types fail loudly.

source.description: A single tracked source. Required: id, kind, status, lifecycle.state, and (per kind) at least one of url-or-path. Additive fields (archived, discovered_via, lifecycle.last_checked, etc.) are tolerated.

id.description: Stable identifier. Used as a cache-path component at bootstrap, where it is additionally constrained to ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$ before being interpolated into a filesystem path.

url.description: Source URL. Required (non-empty) for git-managed and web-doc; absent, explicit null, or empty string for external-doc and local-path. A null or empty string is treated as absent, matching verify.sh's `.url // ""` reading.

path.description: Filesystem path. Required (non-empty) for external-doc and local-path; absent, explicit null, or empty string for web-doc. A null or empty string is treated as absent, matching verify.sh's `.path // ""` reading.

forge.description: git-managed only. Which of the five permalink grammars permalink_density.py (SELF-AUDIT Check 7) credits this source's host under. Optional and additive: absent on every source-paths.json predating this field, and on any host the lint cannot infer from a well-known SaaS hostname (github.com, gitlab.com, bitbucket.org, dev.azure.com) — an absent value keeps the pre-field behavior of crediting that host under any of the five grammars, so leaving it unset never starts rejecting a citation that used to pass. Set it to scope a self-hosted forge (GitHub Enterprise Server, a self-managed GitLab or Bitbucket Server instance) to only its own grammar, so the host is not also credited for a citation shaped like a different forge's permalink.

branch.description: git-managed only; must be git-ref-safe. Absent, null, or empty string ⇒ downstream code uses HEAD. verify.sh validates branch only when it is a non-empty string, so null/empty are accepted as 'unset' (and the git-managed-only rule below likewise fires only for a non-empty branch).

crawl_mode.description: web-doc only. 'sitemap' crawls from a sitemap; 'list' crawls an explicit page_list.

crawl_budget.description: Max pages to crawl. Meaningful for web-doc only, but the [1, 5000] bounds apply whenever the key is present on any kind — verify.sh enforces the same rule, keeping the two enforcers equivalent.

importance.description: Per-source, optional. Priority from 1 (lowest) to 5 (highest) used to order REFRESH's probing under probe_budget. Absent defaults to neutral priority 3.

sitemap_url.description: web-doc crawl_mode 'sitemap' only; absent, explicit null, or empty string when crawl_mode is 'list'.

page_list.description: web-doc crawl_mode 'list' only. Absent, explicit null, or empty array when crawl_mode is 'sitemap'. Each URL must share an origin with the source url (origin equality is enforced by verify.sh, not this schema).

files_of_interest.description: Optional. Non-empty list of gitignore-style path patterns (git --no-cone sparse-checkout syntax, e.g. "docs/**", "src/auth/**", "docs/sso.md"). When present and non-empty, the engine's git-managed clone recipes (engine-bootstrap Step 3.5, DISCOVER's cache-miss offer) substitute a files_of_interest-scoped sparse clone for the unconditional shallow clone. Absent or empty array => unconditional shallow clone, unchanged. See 03-engine.md § files_of_interest-scoped sparse cloning.

workspace_roots.description: Optional. Non-empty list of top-level directory names that verify.sh's monorepo-coverage (Check 6) and catalog-density (Check 8) heuristics treat as workspace roots for this source, replacing (not augmenting) the default list `packages apps libs crates services modules cmd internal pkg`. Set it when a source's monorepo layout does not match the default roots (e.g. a workspace tool with its own top-level convention). See 07-monorepo-adapter.md.
